title: Animal Knowledge Quiz
description: Test your knowledge about amazing animals from around the world!

questions.question: Which is the biggest land animal in the world?
questions.explanation: African elephants are the largest land animals – they can weigh up to 6,000 kg! That's like 100 humans combined! 🐘

questions.question: What do penguins eat?
questions.explanation: Penguins are amazing swimmers that dive deep to catch fish and squid. They can hold their breath for over 20 minutes! 🐧

questions.question: How many legs does an octopus have?
questions.explanation: Octopuses have 8 tentacles (arms), not legs! Each one has suction cups that help them catch food. They're super intelligent too! 🐙

questions.question: What is the fastest land animal?
questions.explanation: Cheetahs are the fastest land animals and can run up to 120 km per hour! They're built for speed. 🐆

questions.question: Which animal sleeps the most?
questions.explanation: Koalas sleep about 20 hours a day! They need lots of rest because eucalyptus leaves give them very little energy. 🐨
